notes: v1.14.555 — THE pg-triage WRITERS ARE CHASED DOWN. The legacy NOW dashboard and the three painters that kept writing into it are deleted: today_render (338 lines), triage_renderDeployCard (88), firstRun_renderChip (15), their 10 call sites, and the 97-line page. ⛔ A USER-VISIBLE BUG CAME OUT WITH THEM, and it was the real find: _session_startFresh called showPage(triage), and START FRESH is a real button in the resume banner. Since v1.14.553 removed the switch, triage is not in the redesign guard whitelist, so every tap fell through to the guard last branch and toasted "Not in the new UI yet: TRIAGE" at the operator before landing on Command anyway — a confusing warning on an action that then worked. It now goes to the home surface directly. ⭐ SAFE TO DELETE OUTRIGHT, checked not assumed: none of the three writes storage, and each touches ONLY elements inside pg-triage (#today-dashboard, #qa-deploy-card, #triage-mission-bar, #fr-chip). They were pure painters into a page nothing could open. today_render ran at every boot and built its whole dashboard string — the :31582 note describes the paint as ~500 localStorage parses when uncached — for a surface no one could see. deploy_quick SURVIVES: the qa-deploy-card that called it went with the page, but the redesign reaches it through its own doors.
